command:
set -u
printf '%s\n' '--- voice unit ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- client unit ---'
systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- omega installed files ---'
for f in omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do p="$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/$f"; if [ -f "$p" ]; then sha256sum "$p"; else echo "MISSING $p"; fi; done
printf '%s\n' '--- dropins ---'
for p in "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d/99-omega-777-organ-floor.conf" "$HOME/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service.d/99-omega-777-organ-floor.conf"; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then echo "FILE $p"; cat "$p"; else echo "MISSING $p"; fi; done
